resources.string: Your own exit via PHP hosting

Experimental mode. Traffic goes not through VLESS servers but through your own exit: the OpenFlux PHP script on ordinary web hosting. Useful when your mobile carrier only lets \"whitelisted\" sites through and your hosting is one of them. TCP only (ports 80/443), speed is modest.
Traffic goes through your exit instead of VLESS servers
First enter a valid exit address and token, then save them.
The address must start with http:// or https://
The address must point to a .php file (e.g. …/phpbox.php)
Without HTTPS your provider can see the token and the site addresses. The content of HTTPS sites stays encrypted.
The VPN is connected: address and token changes apply on reconnect.
How to set up your own exit
1. Download phpbox.php and config.example.php from the openflux-exit branch (button below) — it also has a step-by-step Beget guide.
2. Put your own long random token into config.php.
3. On some hosts (e.g. Beget) set the bus folder outside public_html (see config.example.php).
4. Paste the exit address and the token here.
